cues.text: Anthropic, the company behind Claude, goes public on Thursday, 19 November 2026.
cues.say: Anthropic, the company behind Claude, goes public on Thursday, the nineteenth of November, twenty twenty six.

cues.text: Ticker: ANT, on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.
cues.say: Ticker: A N T, on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.

cues.text: An IPO is the first time a private company sells shares to the public.
cues.say: An I P O is the first time a private company sells shares to the public.

cues.text: After that, anyone can trade them on the exchange.
cues.say: After that, anyone can trade them on the exchange.

cues.text: Revenue: $16.3 billion in the first half of 2026,
cues.say: Revenue: sixteen point three billion dollars in the first half of twenty twenty six,

cues.text: and a reported $16.8 billion in the third quarter alone.
cues.say: and a reported sixteen point eight billion in the third quarter alone.

cues.text: The expectation: raise about $100 billion at a valuation of $1.3 to $1.45 trillion.
cues.say: The expectation: raise about one hundred billion dollars, at a valuation of one point three to one point four five trillion.

cues.text: That would be the largest IPO in history.
cues.say: That would be the largest I P O in history.

cues.text: SpaceX set the record in June: $75 billion raised, shares up 19% on day one.
cues.say: SpaceX set the record in June. Seventy five billion raised, shares up nineteen percent on day one.

cues.text: The IPO is priced on November 18. Shares start trading on Thursday, November 19.
cues.say: The I P O is priced on November eighteenth. Shares start trading on Thursday, November nineteenth.

cues.text: And NVIDIA? The amended filing shows nearly $900 billion of computing commitments, with NVIDIA as Anthropic's largest chip supplier.
cues.say: And NVIDIA? The amended filing shows nearly nine hundred billion dollars of computing commitments, with NVIDIA as Anthropic's largest chip supplier.

cues.text: Chip stocks rose on the filing, and NVIDIA may take a stake of about $10 billion in the IPO.
cues.say: Chip stocks rose on the filing, and NVIDIA may take a stake of about ten billion dollars in the I P O.

cues.text: But Anthropic also buys from Google, Amazon and AMD. A demand signal, not a guarantee.
cues.say: But Anthropic also buys from Google, Amazon and A M D. A demand signal, not a guarantee.

cues.text: The expected IPO price: $70 to $78 per share.
cues.say: The expected I P O price: seventy to seventy eight dollars per share.

cues.text: At the top of the range that values Anthropic at about $1.45 trillion, on roughly 18.6 billion shares.
cues.say: At the top of the range, that values Anthropic at about one point four five trillion dollars, on roughly eighteen point six billion shares.

cues.text: What if the market takes it to $2 trillion?
cues.say: What if the market takes it to two trillion dollars?

cues.text: On the same share count, that is about $108 a share: 38% above the top of the range.
cues.say: On the same share count, that is about one hundred and eight dollars a share. Thirty eight percent above the top of the range.

cues.text: And a higher open is common. SpaceX opened 19% above its IPO price; the same move would put ANT near $93.
cues.say: And a higher open is common. SpaceX opened nineteen percent above its I P O price. The same move would put A N T near ninety three dollars.

cues.text: Watch the final price on November 18, and the opening trade on the 19th.
cues.say: Watch the final price on November eighteenth, and the opening trade on the nineteenth.

cues.text: Shares are highly speculative. This is information, not advice.
cues.say: Shares are highly speculative. This is information, not advice.
